Maria (CS): quick check-in for Helix reserved pool this week :wave:
Maria (CS): noticed GPU hours down ~18% vs last week, queue depth creeping up. can we get top-line metrics (hours, saturation, avg wait, error rate, spend delta)? cc @Sanjay (Ops) @Lenka (CSM)
Sanjay (Ops): grabbing the numbers now, will post short snapshot

Deploy Bot: autoscaler: scaled helix-reserved +2 gpus at 2026-03-17T03:12Z (policy: spike-detection) :robot_face:
Lenka (CSM): Helix onboarding team reported a batch of nightly synthetic tests last Tue that spiked prep jobs — might explain some of the saturation. renewal ~6w out, customer anxious about latency regressions
AJ (Platform): short-term ops play: increase burst capacity to +3 for 24h, enable prefix KV cache for their common prefixes, and move heavy prep jobs to off-peak window. command: `redwoodctl capacity modify --pool helix-reserved --burst 3 --duration 24h`
Kevin (Eng): also recommend a quick config diff and a canary: run model variant with quantization off during low-traffic window to see latency change. low risk and should tell us whether quantization toggles are causing errors
Sanjay (Ops): running `gpu-queue inspect helix-reserved --last 7d` now, will post any anomalous job types. will also drop a flamegraph of KV cache hit rates by EOD
Lenka (CSM): I'll flag renewal risk if errors stay >1% two consecutive weeks. schedule an enablement session with Helix to go over prep-job throttles and cost controls — available slots Thurs/Fri
Maria (CS): plan: 1) Sanjay executes burst + cache checks, posts logs 2) AJ applies burst and schedules canary 3) Kevin runs quantization canary 4) Lenka to book enablement and update renewal risk doc. I'll follow up in next sync. :white_check_mark:
Sanjay (Ops): on it, will post results here (logs + short summary)
AJ (Platform): noted, will coordinate canary and rollback playbook
Lenka (CSM): adding note to the customer record and prepping an enablement slide deck
Maria (CS): thanks team — keep updates short here, ping if anything requires an urgent escalation :phone:
